titolare.title: Data Controller
titolare.intro: The Data Controller for personal data collected through the website {url} is:

volontari.title: Data provided voluntarily
volontari.testo: When you fill in the contact form or send us an email, we collect the data you provide directly: name, email address, phone number and the content of your message. This data is processed exclusively to respond to your enquiry and, with your consent, to send you communications related to the hotel's services.

navigazione.title: Browsing data
navigazione.testo: The IT systems and software procedures used to operate this website acquire, during their normal operation, certain personal data whose transmission is implicit in the use of Internet communication protocols (e.g. IP addresses, browser type, operating system, pages visited, access times).

googleAnalytics.label: Analytics cookies
googleAnalytics.title: Google Analytics
googleAnalytics.paragrafo1: This website uses Google Analytics 4 (GA4), a web analytics service provided by Google LLC. GA4 uses cookies to collect anonymous and aggregated information about website usage, including: number of visitors, referral source, pages viewed, session duration and content interactions.

googleAds.label: Advertising cookies
googleAds.title: Google Ads
googleAds.paragrafo1: This website uses Google Ads services and its conversion tracking system. When a user interacts with a Google ad, a conversion cookie is placed on their device. This cookie is not used for personal identification and is used solely to measure the effectiveness of advertising campaigns.
googleAds.paragrafo2: Data collected through Google Ads may include: ad interactions, landing pages visited and actions completed (e.g. booking request). For more information and to manage your advertising preferences, visit the

necessari.title: Necessary cookies
necessari.testo: Essential for the functioning of the website. They include technical cookies for session management and consent preferences. They do not require user consent and cannot be disabled.

analitici.title: Analytics cookies
analitici.testo: Used by Google Analytics 4 to collect anonymous statistical data on browsing activity. They help us understand how visitors interact with the website, which pages are most visited and how to improve the user experience.

marketing.title: Marketing cookies
marketing.testo: Installed by Google Ads to track advertising conversions and display relevant ads. These cookies may be used to build a profile of your interests and show you relevant advertising on other websites.

dirittiUtente.title: Your rights
dirittiUtente.intro: As a data subject, pursuant to Articles 15-22 of Regulation (EU) 2016/679, you have the right to:

accesso.title: Right of access (Art. 15)
accesso.desc: Obtain confirmation as to whether or not personal data concerning you is being processed and, if so, obtain a copy of that data.

rettifica.title: Right to rectification (Art. 16)
rettifica.desc: Obtain the rectification of inaccurate personal data concerning you without undue delay.

cancellazione.title: Right to erasure (Art. 17)
cancellazione.desc: Obtain the erasure of personal data concerning you when it is no longer necessary for the purposes for which it was collected.

limitazione.title: Right to restriction (Art. 18)
limitazione.desc: Obtain the restriction of processing when you contest the accuracy of the data or the processing is unlawful.

portabilita.title: Right to data portability (Art. 20)
portabilita.desc: Receive personal data concerning you in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.

opposizione.title: Right to object (Art. 21)
opposizione.desc: Object at any time to the processing of personal data concerning you, including profiling.
